_note: Draft English rendering of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Bamidbar 34, generated by scripts/translate_tafsir_english.py against the JA (not the biblical Hebrew). Translation goal: reverse-translatability for the Tafsir reader — readers should be able to map English back to JA. Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: Then God spoke to Moses in speech.
translations.2: Command the sons of Israel and say to them: You are entering the land of Canaan — and these are the borders of the land that shall come to you as an inheritance.
translations.3: And the southern border shall begin for you from the wilderness of Zin, which is beside Edom; and the southern border shall be from the end of the Dead Sea on the east.
translations.4: Then the border shall turn for you from the south of the ascent of Akrabbim, and shall continue to Zin; and its exit shall be to the south of Kadesh-Barnea (Raqim); and it shall go out to Rafah, and continue to Azmon.
translations.5: And it shall turn from Azmon to the Wadi of al-Arish; and its exit shall be to the sea.
translations.6: And the western border — the Great Sea and its boundary shall be for you.
translations.7: And this shall be the northern border for you: from the Great Sea you shall mark out your border to Mount Hor.
translations.8: From it to Hamath; and its exit shall be to Zedad.
translations.9: And it shall go out to Ziphron, and end at Hazar-Enan. This shall be the northern border for you.
translations.10: And you shall mark out the eastern border for yourselves, from Hazar-Enan to Shepham.
translations.11: And the border shall descend from Shepham to Daphneh, east of the spring; then it shall descend and extend to the eastern shore of the Sea of Gennesaret.
translations.12: And the border shall go down along the Jordan, and its exit shall be at the Dead Sea. This shall be your boundary of the land all around.
translations.13: And Moses commanded the sons of Israel, on the word of God, and said: This is the bounded land which you shall apportion by lots, as God commanded — that it be given to nine tribes and a half.
translations.14: For the tribe of Reuben, and the tribe of Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have already taken their inheritance, according to their ancestral houses.
translations.15: These two tribes and the half took their inheritance from across the Jordan of Jericho on the east.
translations.16: Then God spoke to Moses in speech.
translations.17: These are the names of the men who shall apportion the land for you: Eleazar the imām, and Joshua son of Nun.
translations.18: And one noble from each tribe — take him to apportion the land.
translations.19: And these are their names: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb son of Jephunneh.
translations.20: And from the tribe of Simeon, Samuel son of Ammihud.
translations.21: And from the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad son of Kislon.
translations.22: And from the tribe of Dan, a noble: Bukki son of Jogli.
translations.23: For the sons of Joseph, from the tribe of the sons of Manasseh, a noble: Hanniel son of Ephod.
translations.24: And from the tribe of the sons of Ephraim, a noble: Kemuel son of Shiphtan.
translations.25: And for the tribe of Zebulun, a noble: Elizaphan son of Parnach.
translations.26: And from the tribe of Issachar, a noble: Paltiel son of Azzan.
translations.27: And from the tribe of Asher, a noble: Ahihud son of Shelomi.
translations.28: And from the tribe of Naphtali, a noble: Pedahel son of Ammihud.
translations.29: These are those who entered — whom God commanded to apportion the land of Canaan for the sons of Israel.
